title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Fizzy Cherry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elfliq Fizzy Cherry captures the nostalgic and incredibly vibrant taste of a classic Cherry soda. The inhale provides the deep, intensely sweet, and slightly dark notes of ripe Cherry. This rich fruit foundation is then perfectly lifted on the exhale by a lively, sparkling fizz, creating a wonderfully refreshing and dynamic beverage profile. Blended to a versatile 50VG/50PG ratio, this premium nicotine salt e-liquid is perfectly suited for both Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) and Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) vaping. It performs exceptionally well when paired with refillable pod kits and classic vape pens using coils rated between 0.6ohm and 1.2ohm. The use of high-quality nicotine salts ensures a wonderfully smooth throat hit alongside rapid, effective satisfaction. The Elfliq collection brings world-renowned flavour expertise to a convenient 10ml format. Produced to strict regulatory standards and available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium range allows you to experience intensely vivid and highly authentic fruit blends in your preferred refillable device.
